how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-scarlet-monastery-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1048:obj:0: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, ⟦E1⟧ Commander Mograine, Herod, the ⟦E1⟧ Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1048:details:0: Whilst the Dark Lady tends to the pressing issue of the Lich King's advance to the north, I am seeing to it that matters closer to home are being taken care of accordingly.
rows.quest:1048:details:1: BNo doubt, the human pests who call themselves the ⟦E3⟧ are proving to be the sharpest thorn in our side domestically. ⟦E4⟧ is literally crawling with the little red ants.
rows.quest:1048:details:2: BTravel to the Monastery, ⟦1⟧, and lay waste to High Inquisitor Whitemane and her top lieutenants.
rows.quest:1048:completion:0: You have served the Dark Lady well, ⟦2⟧. 'Twas no small task I asked of you.
rows.quest:1048:completion:1: BYour loyalty to the ⟦E5⟧ has been noted. And your tenacity in combat will be remembered.
rows.quest:1049:obj:0: Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery in ⟦E4⟧ and return to Sage Truthseeker in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1049:details:0: The ⟦E7⟧ had pure intentions towards our plagued brethren. But who is to know the motivations of those whispering in the ears of the Elder Council?
rows.quest:1049:details:1: BThe ⟦E5⟧ whom we have allied with have a history wrought with deceit. Too hasty was our pact. Perhaps Cairne would have been wise to heed the warnings from ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1049:details:2: BDeep within the ⟦E1⟧ Monastery lies the Compendium of the Fallen, guarded by crazed human zealots. Their method is forged from insanity but their research might prove useful.
rows.quest:1049:completion:0: The Compendium of the Fallen! I was beginning to wonder if the very book existed!
rows.quest:1049:completion:1: BYou have served the Tauren of ⟦E6⟧ well, ⟦3⟧. Your dedication shall not be forgotten.
rows.quest:1050:obj:0: Retrieve Mythology of the Titans from the Monastery and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:1050:details:0: The future is inevitable! We hurl ourselves towards it like falling raindrops to the Great Sea.
rows.quest:1050:details:1: BBut perhaps, by studying the past, we can know what to expect and be better prepared for the unknown.
rows.quest:1050:details:2: BBefore dire troubles fell upon Lordaeron, there was a bastion of knowledge tucked away in the ⟦E4⟧. It is rumored that a book called Mythology of the Titans was housed in the library of the old Monastery.
rows.quest:1050:details:3: BBring it to me and perhaps together we can unlock the secrets of the past!
rows.quest:1050:completion:0: You have rescued the sacred text!
rows.quest:1050:completion:1: BYour journey was long and acquiring the book was undoubtedly no easy task. But the dwarves of ⟦E9⟧ stand to benefit from your success.
rows.quest:1050:completion:2: BThank you, ⟦4⟧, on behalf of the Explorers' League.
rows.quest:1051:obj:0: Return Vorrel Sengutz's wedding ring to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:1051:details:0: Even though my will is free, I can serve the Dark Lady no more. I feel my time on ⟦E10⟧ has come to an end. My life force is shattered.
rows.quest:1051:details:1: BInterrogator Vishas did this to me! Tortured me for weeks! Took my wedding ring and gave it to his wife. The bastard!
rows.quest:1051:details:3: BThe pompous fool bragged about his precious wife, Nancy, who lived along Lake Lordamere. Track the wench down, slay her and return my wedding ring to my wife, Monika in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:1051:completion:0: Vorrel led such a troubled existence. And what a good mate he was...
rows.quest:1051:completion:2: BVorrel is gone, never to enjoy undeath again. At least I can take solace in the revenge you took in his name. For that I thank you.
rows.quest:1051:completion:3: BNow let me be to mourn....
rows.quest:1053:obj:0: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, ⟦E1⟧ Commander Mograine, Herod, the ⟦E1⟧ Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Raleigh the Devout in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1053:details:0: I once served the ⟦E3⟧ with honor, loyalty and pride. I believed their cause to be a noble one: to rid ⟦E10⟧ of the undead.
rows.quest:1053:details:1: BBut as I spent time at the Monastery in ⟦E4⟧ I realized that their grasp on reality was slipping. They now think everyone is plagued who doesn't wear the tabard of the Crusade. Innocent men and women were tortured because they were supposedly plagued.
rows.quest:1053:details:2: BThe ⟦E3⟧ must be crushed in the name of the Light. You, ⟦5⟧, must destroy the deranged regime.
rows.quest:1053:completion:0: While disciples of the Light never revel in the loss of life, we must accept that on occasion, such sacrifices must happen for the greater good of the Kingdom and the planet.
rows.quest:1053:completion:1: BThrough your deeds in the Monastery you have spared many innocent lives, ⟦6⟧. I salute your tenacity.
rows.quest:1113:obj:0: Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E2⟧ wants 20 Hearts of Zeal.
rows.quest:1113:details:0: Why do I need a rare type of guano, you might ask. Well, for this experiment I want to see what effect two diametrically opposed chemical substances can have on each other, especially when both are combined with an ever-toxic agent to ensure the most... ghastly results.
rows.quest:1113:details:1: BIn the northeastern peaks of ⟦E4⟧ lies the ⟦E1⟧ Monastery. There the crazed disciples of the ⟦E3⟧ congregate, both inside and outside the halls. Which you slay matters not, any of them may have the heart I need.
rows.quest:1113:completion:0: My what an abundance of gore you have brought me, ⟦7⟧! Your efforts have been most excellent!
rows.quest:1160:obj:0: Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1160:details:0: I will tell you what you must seek, and I will even ask you my question, but not because you wish to prove yourself. Knowledge is far more important than strength. Even as others seem to pass you by in ability, your knowledge of the world will be more valuable.
rows.quest:1160:details:1: BGo to the Monastery in the north of ⟦E4⟧. In the library there, a book called Beginnings of the Undead Threat resides. It was used by the now-corrupt paladins there to train them to fight my kind.
rows.quest:1160:completion:0: This is the book I sent you to search for.
rows.quest:1160:completion:1: B<Parqual slowly caresses his hand over the top of the book as he stares down at it.>
rows.quest:1160:completion:2: BSo now you wish a question to prove your mind is as powerful as your body and spirit. If you have studied the book long enough, then I shall ask you your question and you can be done with these tests!
